title: Restore My Quest access for every authenticated member by repairing its exact stale page setting

source.ref: Read-only Frequency Community root page_settings metadata and current admission source, 2026-11-04.

detail:

Production metadata confirms exactly one root Space and its /crew page_settings row is published, visibility_role=crew, updated_at=2026-06-22 15:21:37.887+00. The community crew rung is retired and separate from paid Crew entitlement. Current Quest matrix and docs/ROLES.md grant every signed-in member full Quest access, while the shared layout still honors this stale operator visibility gate. PROPOSAL ONLY: exact operator transaction resolves one root, locks only /crew, refuses unless status/visibility/updated_at still match this reviewed snapshot, sets native visibility_role NULL (any authenticated member) and updated_at, verifies one row and unchanged remaining columns. No generic page gate, auth, RLS, role or unrelated route changes. The exact SQL passed eleven disposable PGlite 0.4.0 / PostgreSQL 17.5-compatible fixture cases, including unchanged unrelated rows and rollback/refusal cases; this is not hosted Supabase equivalence. Fresh compare-and-set preflight, exact main-committed SQL hash review/authorization and actual production postconditions are still required before any production execution. Never execute twice; an already-null or changed row refuses. Acceptance: authenticated member /crew reaches My Quest, guest remains signed out, other host-only/draft routes and other Space settings stay enforced.

CLOSED 2026-11-04, core metadata repair only. The preceding proposal/pre-repair facts are historical. #4667 is main d8787e6d5e98c5855cef36adf8b5c0dbe6922a68 and exact production deployment dpl_8Z7oKcim73NCtLJNGY6TZjHbn2LS is READY for frequencylocal.com. Daniel specifically approved the exact committed operator SQL SHA-256 258956ee13d656f2b67959fc9a4c3c15690dc3e6a1740d0ced9d2127e1e43cec; it was executed ONCE and must never be rerun. Independent before/after metadata confirms exactly one root and target, still published, visibility_role now native NULL, with other target-column hash and unrelated control-row hash preserved. Actual existing authenticated production /crew now renders My Quest at 1280px with scrollWidth 1280px; no challenge, reward or session interaction was performed. An ordinary no-cookie HTTP GET returns 307 to /sign-in?next=%2Fcrew, confirming server-side anonymous admission remains closed. Six actual-current-main access/predicate controls preserve ordinary-member access, stale-crew refusal reproduction, native NULL admission, draft refusal and host-only semantics. This closes the scoped stale-setting repair, not a role-wide or all-device audit: actual 390 px mobile render, separate signed-out browser journey and wide role matrix were not exercised. No auth/RLS/grants/source gate changes or further operator action are part of this closure.
